hypothesis_and_decision.hypothesis: A fairly adapted 361,821,120-parameter SmolLM2 baseline may outperform BarunAction-35M candidate-v2 on strict Mobile Actions development Action IR exact match.
hypothesis_and_decision.decision: Preserve one final-checkpoint result as first matched public-development evidence. Do not tune from it inside this run and do not treat it as a larger-model-superiority test.
hypothesis_and_decision.trial_budget: one full-SFT recipe, one seed, one final development score

baseline.parameter_count_gate: deduplicate exact tied storage views after loading; abort unless measured count is exactly 361,821,120 and all unique parameters are trainable

matched_information.semantic_contract: same IDs, schemas, tool order, descriptions, timestamp, user text, Action IR labels, no augmentations, no teacher information, and exactly one presentation of every training row
matched_information.model_specific_difference: only native chat control tokens and tokenizer tokenization

official_eval_firewall.remote_stage_policy: stage train manifest, dev manifest, and audit only; do not stage the combined source or any official-eval artifact
official_eval_firewall.required_audit_state: opaque, unparsed, unmaterialized, untokenized, unsummarized, and excluded from overlap calculations

evaluation.population: frozen grouped 756-row Mobile Actions development manifest
evaluation.failure_accounting: missing, OOM, context-overflow, truncated, parse-invalid, and schema-invalid outputs remain failures

frozen_implementation.local_verification: 180 full repository tests passed at freeze time; repository-wide Ruff check passed; matched-baseline files passed Ruff format check; all 8,693 permitted train/dev prompts passed strict semantic-wrapper parsing

compute.plan: after a fresh read-only inventory and clean-stage hash, create one new project-owned H200 in IN2 through infra/jarvis/safe_run.py, download essential evidence, and pause-verify only its exact recorded ID

claim_limit: This one-seed, one-recipe public-development comparison cannot establish official-test performance, safety, a matched training-procedure advantage, or that BarunAction-35M beats a larger model.
